caption:
Today is a Monkey day 🐒 Pause on your animal.

Every day has an animal. Today's Monkey meets the animal of the year you were born: Snake gets a best-friend day, Rat and Dragon a team day, Tiger a clash day. Born in Jan or early Feb? Use the animal before yours.

Your animal is your Season. The element of the day you were born is your Sky. Find both free at the link in bio.

Tag someone born in your year 👇

day_line: The ocean under turning leaves. Big and restless: good for big ideas, easy to drift.

lines.Yang Wood: Big thoughts on a slow Sunday. Write one down; don't redesign your whole life tonight.
lines.Yin Wood: Lazy Sunday is approved today. Nap first, then get ready for Monday.
lines.Yang Fire: Sunday scaries show up early. Make a short list, then go for a walk.
lines.Yin Fire: Be on time for the family lunch today. Someone is quietly keeping score.
lines.Yang Earth: A good tip comes up in casual chat today. Note it down; check it on Monday.
lines.Yin Earth: Sort out the week's budget today. Ten minutes now beats panic on Thursday.
lines.Yang Metal: Do something just for fun today. Karaoke counts. Volume control also counts.
lines.Yin Metal: You'll have a strong take at dinner today. Say it with a smile and pass the sambal.
lines.Yang Water: Everyone's on your wavelength today. Make plans, but let someone else book.
lines.Yin Water: Someone gets the credit or the last durian today. Breathe; your turn is coming.

animal_tips.Rat: Team up today. Two heads, less work.
animal_tips.Ox: Slow Sunday. Prep one thing for Monday.
animal_tips.Tiger: Skip the argument. Go for a walk.
animal_tips.Rabbit: Tidy your bag. Small calm, big win.
animal_tips.Dragon: Lead the group plan. They'll follow.
animal_tips.Snake: Message a friend. They're free today.
animal_tips.Horse: Get some sun. Charge your batteries.
animal_tips.Goat: Cook something simple and share it.
animal_tips.Monkey: Your day. Back your own idea.
animal_tips.Rooster: Plan the week, then switch off.
